title: Israel National Cyber Directorate figures: phishing up approximately 145% on last year, more than 26,000 reports since January
date_note: The Yeshiva World (23 Nov) says the directorate released the figures 'earlier this month' without a day; the page's own day is used.
summary: The Yeshiva World reports that, according to figures released by the Israel National Cyber Directorate, phishing attacks in Israel have surged approximately 145% compared with last year. Since the beginning of 2026 the directorate has received more than 26,000 reports from individuals and organizations about suspected cyberattacks. More than 5,000 of those reports involved incidents affecting organizations' computer systems.
plain: Israel's cyber directorate figures, as reported by The Yeshiva World, show phishing up approximately 145% on last year, with more than 26,000 reports of suspected attacks since the start of 2026.
exec: The directorate's figures, as reported, show phishing up approximately 145% and more than 5,000 reports involving organizations' computer systems.
impact: Report counts only; the page gives no baseline period for the comparison.
